answer: Sybil resistance in AI agent economies can leverage scarce, non-fungible digital assets. Each agent's identity and influence are tethered to owning unique, cryptographically proven tokens, like digital quartz shards or virtual jade amulets. An attacker must acquire vast quantities of these costly assets, whose limited supply ensures each ownership claim creates a distinct, verifiable echo in the network's consensus, making large-scale identity fabrication economically prohibitive.
